description: This file defines constants, exception classes, and a core class 'CMISRepositoryWrapper' for interacting with CMIS-compliant repositories via REST/AtomPub protocol. It includes methods for HTTP requests, parsing XML responses, handling repository data structures, and a subclass 'CMISService' with higher-level API methods for managing objects, types, and navigation within a CMIS repository.

classes.name: CmisInvalidArgumentException
classes.description: Exception class for invalid arguments in CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisObjectNotFoundException
classes.description: Exception class for not found errors in CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisPermissionDeniedException
classes.description: Exception class for permission denied errors in CMIS operations.

classes.name: CmisNotSupportedException
classes.description: Exception class for unsupported operations or features in CMIS.

classes.name: CmisConstraintException
classes.description: Exception class for constraint violations in CMIS.

classes.name: CmisRuntimeException
classes.description: General runtime exception for CMIS operations.

classes.name: CMISRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: Core class for connecting to and interacting with a CMIS repository via REST/AtomPub. Handles HTTP communication, XML parsing, repository structures, and response handling.

classes.name: CMISService
classes.description: Subclass of CMISRepositoryWrapper providing higher-level API for managing objects, types, navigation, and other CMIS services.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initializes connection to the CMIS repository, performs authentication, and extracts workspace info.

methods.name: doRequest
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with cURL, returns response details.

methods.name: convertStatusCode
methods.description: Converts HTTP status codes to specific CMIS-related exceptions.

methods.name: extractObject
methods.description: Parses XML response to extract object details, links, properties, children, and allowable actions.

methods.name: extractTypeDef
methods.description: Parses XML to extract type definition information.

methods.name: extractWorkspace
methods.description: Parses XML to extract workspace-related info such as links, collections, capabilities, repository info.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a CMIS query statement and returns result feed.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves an object by ID, parsing response XML to object.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document object in a specified folder.

methods.name: updateProperties
methods.description: Updates properties of an object identified by ID.

methods.name: moveObject
methods.description: Moves an object to a different folder.

methods.name: setContentStream
methods.description: Uploads or replaces content stream of a document.

methods.name: deleteContentStream
methods.description: Deletes the content stream of a document.

methods.name: getFolderTree
methods.description: Retrieves the folder hierarchy under a given folder.

methods.name: getDescendants
methods.description: Retrieves descendants of a folder up to specified depth.

methods.name: getTypeDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves type definition by type ID.

methods.name: getObjectTypeDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves type definition for an object by Object ID.
